name: marcumq
expr: r1 = marcumq(2, 1); r2 = marcumq(1, 2); r3 = marcumq(2, 3, 2);
comment: Sig Q=marcumq(a,b[,m]): generalized Marcum Q-function. marcumq(2,1)=0.918108 (b<a -> near 1), marcumq(1,2)=0.269012 (b>a -> small), marcumq(2,3,2)=0.352698 (order m=2). tol 1e-5: numkit's series approximation differs from MATLAB by ~5e-7.
